text: Reyrolle 7SR18: Line Differential Protection Relay | Siemens

Reyrolle 7SR18 delivers advanced line differential protection for overhead lines and cables in transmission and distribution networks. This numerical relay ensures fast, secure fault clearance with integrated backup protection and communication flexibility.
